caveat: wall clock measured while other processes (concurrent doc edits and test runs, plus other projects) were using the CPU, so it is an upper bound; the same pipeline measured 396 s on a warm cache
method: git clone from GitHub into a clean directory outside the working tree; uv sync --frozen with a fresh empty UV_CACHE_DIR and a new .venv; then the README quick-start commands in order with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (make is not installed on the verification machine; the Makefile reproduce target runs the same ten stages in the same order)
note: clone+checkout took ~16 s and is included in total_seconds but not in pipeline_seconds
